results.name: C1.1: (111) midplane separates FCC without hitting vertices
results.details: Min distance: 2.886751e-01, vertices on plane: 0. Layer count: 11.

results.name: C1.2: ABCABC stacking: 3 distinct layer heights per period
results.details: Distinct heights mod period: 4 (expected 3 for ABCABC). Heights: [0.       0.57735  1.154701 1.732051]

results.name: C1.3: FCC nearest-neighbor distance = a/sqrt(2)
results.details: Expected: 0.707107, got: 0.707107. Correct FCC lattice constant relationship.

results.name: C1.4: FCC coordination number = 12
results.details: Neighbors at distance a/sqrt(2): 12 (expected 12). 6 in-layer + 3 above + 3 below.

results.name: C2.1: Action decomposition: Tr(T^L) = Z_FCC
results.details: Max error: 1.12e-16. Diagonal transfer matrix consistent with partition function from Prop 2.5.2b.

results.name: C2.2: Eigenvalue exponents chi_2 = 3N_s, F = 8N_s per layer
results.details: lambda_3(N_s=3) formula consistent. Exponents: d_R^(3*N_s) * a_R^(8*N_s).

results.name: C2.3: Crossing plaquettes per boundary = 8*N_s (face count match)
results.details: Expected crossing faces per N_s=1: 8. Matches per-layer face count F = 8*N_s from Prop 2.5.2b. Each crossing cell contributes independently.

results.name: C3.1: a_R(beta=4) > 0 for all 22 SU(3) irreps
results.details: Min a_R = 1.051500e-04 at rep (3, 3). Gangolli's theorem confirmed numerically.

results.name: C3.2: a_R(beta=0.05) > 0 at very strong coupling
results.details: a_1 = 1.000070e+00, a_3 = 2.789546e-03, a_8 = 8.729387e-06. Heat kernel coefficients positive even at strong coupling.

results.name: C3.3: a_R(beta=30) > 0 at weak coupling
results.details: Min a_R = 1.004870e+08. All coefficients approach 1 (equal weight) at weak coupling.

results.name: C3.4: a_R(beta) monotonically increasing in beta
results.details: Tested 4 representations across 6 beta values. Monotonicity confirmed (hotter Boltzmann weight favors all reps).

results.name: C4.1: lambda_R > 0 for all R and all beta in [0.1, 50]
results.details: Min eigenvalue: 1.535973e-54. Strict positivity confirmed across 8 coupling values.

results.name: C4.2: Eigenvalue ordering: lambda_1 > lambda_3 > lambda_8 (confined)
results.details: At beta=2.0: lambda_1=2.676503e+00, lambda_3=5.415142e-06, lambda_8=8.590133e-12. Trivial rep dominates in confined phase.

results.name: C4.3: Factorization: lambda_R(N_s=2) = [lambda_R(N_s=1)]^2
results.details: Max error: 1.83e-16. Eigenvalues factor as (d_R^3 * a_R^8)^N_s.

results.name: C4.4: Charge conjugation: lambda_{(p,q)} = lambda_{(q,p)}
results.details: Max error: 2.42e-14 across 18 conjugate pairs. C-symmetry of Wilson action verified.

results.name: C5.1: Positive spectral gap in confined phase
results.details: mu(beta=2) = 13.1108 (u_3 = 0.128628). Positive gap confirms confinement.

results.name: C5.2: Mass gap vanishes at critical coupling
results.details: Phase transition found at beta_c ~ 11.5. u_3^crit = 3^(-3/8) = 0.662338. Gap vanishes when fundamental overtakes trivial.

results.name: C5.3: Intensive gap mu(beta) is N_s-independent
results.details: mu(N_s=1) = 9.457600, mu(N_s=3) = 9.457600, rel_err = 1.88e-16. Intensive gap confirmed independent of spatial volume.

results.name: C6.1: Strong coupling: a_1 -> 1, a_3 -> 0
results.details: a_1(beta=0.01) = 1.000003, a_3(beta=0.01) = 5.560201e-04. At strong coupling, only trivial rep contributes.

results.name: C6.2: Weak coupling: u_R approaches 1 (reps equalize)
results.details: At beta=15.0: u_3 = 0.7396, u_8 = 0.5104. Heat kernel ratios approach 1 at weak coupling.

results.name: C6.3: SU(2) sub-embedding: a_{(p,0)} > 0 for p = 0..5
results.details: All a_{(p,0)} positive. Consistent with SU(2) heat kernel positivity.

results.name: C6.4: lambda_1 >= lambda_R for all R at beta=1 (confined)
results.details: lambda_1 = 1.264245e+00. All 21 excited eigenvalues are smaller. Ground state dominance in confined phase.
